text: Make me pie, a bamboo worm, kiss my dinner, eat the well, walk a shank, trees on medicine, a green cake, a green cake. Where's my pepper? Who's cool now? Bones on the debris, ears on mice, crap for the chimneys and dodge my thoughts, a green cake, a green cake.
